mechanism: Modafinil inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing amiodarone plasma concentrations and QT prolongation risk; amiodarone may also inhibit modafinil metabolism via CYP3A4.
action: Monitor ECG for QT prolongation and amiodarone toxicity signs; consider modafinil dose reduction or alternative wakefullness-promoting agent; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
